title: A coord.py claim carries the budget the operator approved and the digest shows its spend so far
goal: coord.py claim takes an optional --budget USD the operator approved for the claimed item (its key, an item id), and coord.py list shows beside each live claim budget_usd, spend_usd and over_budget and digest says over budget, the spend read through backlog.py cost's reader (bl_cost) for the item and priced with bench_core.PRICE; a claim past its budget is listed as over budget and nothing is stopped automatically.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
T="_tools/coord.py"
if not os.path.isfile(T):print("coord.py missing: SP-rsmmwzr2 adds it");sys.exit(1)
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"coord.sqlite"))
def c(*a):p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300);return p.returncode,p.stdout
spent,fresh="ST-gtfpib5q","ST-aaaaaaaa"
r1,o1=c("claim",spent,"--ttl","60","--budget","0.000001");r2,_=c("claim",fresh,"--ttl","60","--budget","5")
try:L={x.get("key"):x for x in json.loads(c("list","--prefix","ST-")[1])}
except ValueError:L={}
a,b=L.get(spent,{}),L.get(fresh,{})
dg=c("digest","--key",spent,"--lines","5")[1].lower()
tok=(json.loads(o1) if r1==0 else {}).get("token")
res=dict(claims=r1==0 and r2==0,spend_read=(a.get("spend_usd") or 0)>0 and b.get("spend_usd")==0,budget_kept=a.get("budget_usd")==0.000001 and b.get("budget_usd")==5,
 over_flag=a.get("over_budget") is True and b.get("over_budget") is False,digest_says="over budget" in dg,nothing_stopped=c("renew",spent,"--token",str(tok))[0]==0)
print(res,a,b);sys.exit(0 if all(res.values()) else 1)
